page.layout: One printed page. Main text in one column, full width, with running text from the previous page at the top. Marginal notes in the right margin, beside the lines they belong to. Catchword "quantus" below the last line of the column, at right. Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: tur: Solam fidem justificare: Hominem damnari non posse, modò tantùm credas. Sic Fevardenti-us. Quartò, {m}Bozius, de signis Ecclesia,lib. 6. cap. 5. circa medium, § Bene habet.Ut aeternam salutem consequaris, & sis sanctus, aiunt Protestantes omnes, nihil est necesse boni aliquid velis, moliaris, aut facias: Christo fidas, impune quidvis audeas, & ad exitum perducas. Sic Bozius. Hactenus Ad-versarii ipsi, omissis aliis, qui non minùs rabidè in Protestantes eodem nomine involant & invehuntur. Hæc dici potuisse, & non potuisse refelli? Imò vel facillimè.
main_text.head: II. Thesis.

p.i: Immanem injuriam Protestantibus factam esse per criminationes istas, ex Protestantium scriptis ostenditur.

main_text.head: SECT. III.
main_text.p: PRotestantes in primis duo sunt, per quorum latera professionem eorum omnium Pontificii (in locis citatis) percellere & transfodere conantur: Lutherus & Calvinus. Satis erit primo in loco, ex ipsorum tabulis obsignatis calumniam propulsare, nè præjudicio præfinito rectum præfocetur judicium. {n}In Domi-nic. 1. Ad-vent.tract. de bonis o-peribus, pag.8.Lutherus in hunc modum, In fide & dilectione sita est vita Christiana syncera. Si quaeras quae sint bona opera quae debemus; dico, Te totum, quantus

page.notes: Top line is a fragment continuing from the previous page ("tur:"). The thesis heading is printed in spaced type and was read as a part heading (level 2). "SECT." is read as SECTIO (level 1, caput 3). The marginal note "de signis" is read with some doubt because of the faint print. The first marginal note is printed at the top right, beside "Quartò". The catchword "quantus" is at the foot right. Faint show-through in the left and right margins is ignored.
